items.question: In the UAE free zone business licence process, how many working days does it take to receive the licence after applying online through the free zone authority?
items.gold: After review and approval, the licence is issued within 14 working days.
items.fact: Free zone business licence issued within 14 working days after approval

items.question: Which types of legal entity can be set up in a UAE free zone?
items.gold: Private Limited Liability Company (LLC), Free Zone Company (FZ Co.), Free Zone Establishment (FZE), Public Limited Liability Company (PJSC), or branch of a local or international company.
items.fact: Five legal entity types available for free zone company setup
